title: Balanced L3 boundedness of the trilinear Hilbert transform
exact_target: For Schwartz functions f1,f2,f3 on R, let $T(f1,f2,f3)(x)=pv$ integral f1(x+t)f2(x+2t)f3(x+3t) dt/t. Is $||T(f1,f2,f3)||_L1$ $<=$ C $product_j$ $||fj||_L3$ for one finite absolute C?
